text: The initiative features rapid cabinet mobilisation and inter-ministerial coordination, focusing on maintaining local government service continuity, especially drinking water. It aligns with a science-based risk outlook provided by NIWA and is part of a growing policy emphasis on transitioning from reactive assistance to resilience-building measures.
